authority.source: UrAi Generic World Library governed modular specification; generic exploration candidate

prompt: Original generic modular architecture-shell; one separable asset, not a whole environment. No real place/person, brands, logos, visible text, sci-fi, low-poly filler, floating parts or intersecting geometry. Physically plausible PBR, believable wear, correct UVs/normals; meter scale, +Y up, reusable grounded pivot. Tall north-wall window rhythm, classroom opening centered toward hallway, board surface on front wall. Desk banks have separate child furniture variants; cameras and navigation retain adult access clearance. Target bounding dimensions 8.4m wide x 3m high x 7.6m deep. Materials: paint-institutional-soft. Clear passage where applicable; no arms/hands, forced characters or inaccessible hazards. GLB with embedded PBR textures. Generic exploration candidate only; visual/rights review required.
